paite: Huan Judah vaihawm akum kuana akha sawmna ah Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar leh asepaihte'n Jerusalem asual ua, a-um uh.
heading: Jerusalem Pukna
english: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army came against Jerusalem, and besieged it.

paite: Zedekiah vaihawm kum sawm-le-khatna akha lina, ani kuana ah khopi kulh aphu pailet uh.
english: In the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth day of the month, a breach was made in the city.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jerusalem alak un Babulon kumpipa heutute a hong lut ua, kongpi laita ah atu ua, Nergal-shar-ezar, Samgar-nebo, Sarsekim, Rab-saris mi Nergal-shar-ezar, Rab-mag mi leh Babulon kumpipa heutu dangte toh.
english: All the princes of the king of Babylon came in, and sat in the middle gate: Nergal Sharezer, Samgarnebo, Sarsechim the Rabsaris, Nergal Sharezer the Rabmag, with all the rest of the princes of the king of Babylon.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Judah kumpipa Zedekiah leh galkapmi tengteng in amau amuh un ataikek ua, khopi a kipan zan in kumpipa huai lampi lam ah kulhbaang nih kikal kongpi ah ataikhia ua, amah pen Arabah lampi lam ah apawt hi.
english: When Zedekiah the king of Judah and all the men of war saw them, then they fled and went out of the city by night, by the way of the king’s garden, through the gate between the two walls; and he went out toward the Arabah.

paite: Himahleh Kaldaite sepaihhon in amah adelh ua, Jeriko Phaizang ah Zedekiah apha ua; huchi in amat nung un Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar kiang ah, Hamath gam a Riblah ah api ua, ama'n atungthu angaihtuah hi.
english: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. When they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he pronounced judgment on him.

paite: Huchi in Babulon kumpipa'n Riblah ah amah mitmuh ngei in Zedekiah tapate athat a, Babulon kumpipa'n Judah mihoih teng leng athat lai hi.
english: Then the king of Babylon killed Zedekiah’s sons in Riblah before his eyes. The king of Babylon also killed all the nobles of Judah.

paite: Huai lou leng Zedekiah mit akhelkhia a, kol abunsak a, Babulon ah apita hi.
english: Moreover he put out Zedekiah’s eyes and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.

paite: Kaldaite'n kumpipa' inn leh midang inn tengteng ahal ua, Jerusalem kulhbaangte leng ahihsia uh.
english: The Chaldeans burned the king’s house and the people’s houses with fire and broke down the walls of Jerusalem.

paite: Huan ngakmi heutu Nebuzaradan in khopi a mipi khosuaksun akiang a amau a kipiate leh mipi omlaite Babulon ah sal in api hi.
english: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the rest of the people who remained in the city, the deserters also who fell away to him, and the rest of the people who remained.

paite: Himahleh ngakmi heutu Nebuzaradan in Judah gam migenthei bangmah neiloute anusia a, grephuan leh loute ape pah ngal hi.
english: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, who had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.

paite: Huan Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in Jeremiah tungtang thu a ngakmi Nebuzaradan kiang ah,
heading: Jeremiah Khahkhiakna
english: Now Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon commanded Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard concerning Jeremiah, saying,

paite: "Amah pi inla, hoihtak in bawl inla, hihna himhim ke'n, na kiang a agen bangbang in hih zel zaw in," chi in thu apia hi.
english: “Take him and take care of him. Do him no harm; but do to him even as he tells you.”

paite: Huan ngakmi heutu Nebuzaradan in Rab-saris mi Nebushazban, Rab-mag mi Nergal-shar-ezar leh Babulon kumpipa sepaih heutu deuhdeuhte athukhak vek a, amau Jeremiah ngakmi huangsung a kipan asamkhia ua,
english: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, Nebushazban, Rabsaris, and Nergal Sharezer, Rabmag, and all the chief officers of the king of Babylon

paite: Shaphan tapa Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kiang ah a-inn a puak ding in akemsak ua, huchi in mite lak ah a-omta hi.
english: sent and took Jeremiah out of the court of the guard, and committed him to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, that he should bring him home. So he lived among the people.

paite: Huan ngakmi huangsung a khakkhum a a-om lai in, Jeremiah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
heading: Ebed-melek Dia Lametna
english: Now Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah while he was shut up in the court of the guard, saying,

paite: Ethiopia mi Ebed-melek kiang ah, "Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: Ngai in, ahoihna ding hilou in, hiai khopi siatna ding in ka thute ka hon tun ding a, huai ni mahmah in na ma ah tangtunsak ahi ding.
english: “Go, and speak to Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will bring my words on this city for evil, and not for good; and they will be accomplished before you in that day.

paite: Huai ni in nang bel ka hon hunkhe ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, na mi kihtakte khut ah piak na hi kei ding.
english: But I will deliver you in that day,” says Yahweh; “and you will not be given into the hand of the men of whom you are afraid.

paite: Nang ka hon humbit ding a, namsau in na puk kei ding a, kei na hon muan ziak in, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, chi in va gen in," achi hi.
english: For I will surely save you. You won’t fall by the sword, but you will escape with your life, because you have put your trust in me,” says Yahweh.’”
